import re

def sanitize_control_characters(text: str) -> str:
    """Removes invisible control characters (such as \x18) while preserving standard whitespace."""
    # Matches ASCII control characters from 0 to 31 excluding tab (\x09), newline (\x0a), and carriage return (\x0d)
    pattern = re.compile(r'[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x7f]')
    return pattern.sub('', text)

            # Use the existing context or create a new one, then open a new tab/window

            time.sleep(3)  # Brief pause for dynamic content rendering

            images = page.locator("img")
            count = images.count()
            clicked = False
            
            for i in range(count):
                img = images.nth(i)
                try:
                    if img.is_visible():
                        img.click(force=True)
                        clicked = True
                        print(f"Successfully clicked visible image at index {i}")

                except Exception:
                    continue
            
            if not clicked:
                # Fallback to force clicking the first image if visibility check fails
                images.first.click(force=True)
                print("Clicked first image using fallback.")
            
            print("Verification successful: 2005 GXR picture opened.")

        finally:
